attribute.name: SrcPartition
attribute.description: Name of a partition which contains IS server with input data, leave empty to use application partition

attribute.name: SrcISInfo
attribute.description: Name of an IS info object which contains input data. See OLC2COOL.OnlPrefLumi configuration.

attribute.name: DstPartition
attribute.description: Name of a partition which contains IS server for output data, leave empty to use application partition

attribute.name: DstISInfo
attribute.description: Name of an IS info object which will contain output data.

attribute.name: StableBeamsPartition
attribute.description: Partition containing IS server for stable beam flag.

attribute.name: StableBeamsISInfo
attribute.description: Name if IS info object for stable beam flag.

attribute.name: LumiChangePercent
attribute.description: Threshold for relative change in instantaneous luminosity, in percent. Used for stable beams only.

attribute.name: LumiChangePercentUnstable
attribute.description: Threshold for relative change in instantaneous luminosity, in percent. For non-stable beams periods.

attribute.name: UnstableDeadBand
attribute.description: Luminosity threshold, values below taht are assumed to be zero during non-stable beams periods.

attribute.name: MinLBLength
attribute.description: Minimum LB length in seconds, shorter LBs are discarded.

attribute.name: NoCTPUpdate
attribute.description: If true then pass -N option to ctpUpdateCommand

attribute.name: LogLevel
attribute.description: Application logging level, one of INFO, DEBUG, or WARNING

attribute.name: Log2ERS
attribute.description: If true then enable logging to ERS

attribute.name: RunMode
attribute.description: If value is SoR then current run number is used for IOV start, if value is EoR then next run number is used for IOV start. Normally this should match start of lifetime of the application.

attribute.name: LBNumber
attribute.description: LB number to use as a start of IOV, default is 0.

attribute.name: Mu
attribute.description: Value to use for Mu field in the invalidated record.

attribute.name: Valid
attribute.description: Value to use for Valid field in the invalidated record, default is 2.

attribute.name: ISPartition
attribute.description: Partition name for IS server, leave empty to use application partition.

attribute.name: ISObject
attribute.description: Name of the IS object to use for run number.

attribute.name: MaxRunDiff
attribute.description: Maximum allowed difference between last stored run number from COOL and new run number to be stored, use 0 to disable check.

attribute.name: CoolDb
attribute.description: COOL database connection string, leave empty to use default.

attribute.name: CoolFolder
attribute.description: COOL folder name, leave empty to use default.

attribute.name: CoolTag
attribute.description: COOL tag name, leave empty to use default.

attribute.name: CoolChannel
attribute.description: COOL channel number, default is 0.
